sources: Trophy names, tiers and descriptions are the official PlayStation 5 trophy list for Grand Theft Auto VI, as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles (list frozen 2026-11-18).

Every guide below is written for this app from the official trophy description quoted on each card. Where a description is deliberately cryptic (the hidden trophies), the guide says so and stays general rather than inventing specifics.

trophies.guide: The platinum, awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing separate to do for it: work through the roadmap in this app, keep an eye on the handful of trophies flagged as potentially missable, and this pops the moment your last bronze, silver or gold lands. Basis: the official description congratulates you on becoming a 'Leonida Legend', which is the platinum's way of saying the whole list is done.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the game, so simply start the story and play through the introduction until it concludes; the trophy pops on completion. Basis: the official description names the mission directly, so no preparation or side content is needed first.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Keep following the main mission markers after the opening and this pops when Chapter 1 wraps up. If you are chasing the platinum, nothing in this chapter needs special preparation, so play it naturally. Basis: the official description ties the trophy to finishing Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Progress through the main storyline into and through Chapter 2 and the trophy is awarded at the chapter's end. Basis: the official description ties the trophy to completing Chapter 2; the censored title is reproduced exactly as it appears on the official list.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Continue the main story through Chapter 3 and this pops as the chapter closes. Basis: the official description ties the trophy to completing Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story-related and unmissable. Play through Chapter 4 of the main story and the trophy lands at its conclusion. By this point it is worth having started the collectible and activity grinds in the roadmap, but nothing in this chapter itself can be missed. Basis: the official description ties the trophy to completing Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the campaign. Play the story through to its final mission and complete it; the trophy pops with the ending. Before starting the finale, tidy up anything you want done with your current save state, then enjoy the ending — the free-roam clean-up for 100% completion can continue afterwards. Basis: the official description ties this gold trophy to completing the final mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story-related. Breakfast Run is one of the named story missions: follow the main storyline and it will come up in sequence; finish it and the trophy pops. Basis: the official description names the mission, so it cannot be earned anywhere else or earlier.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story-related. The Cartel Heist is a named set-piece mission in the main storyline; play through it when it arrives and the trophy is awarded on completion, whatever approach you take inside the mission. Basis: the official description names the mission directly.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story-related. Child's Play is a named story mission that arrives as you follow the main plot; complete it and the trophy pops. Basis: the official description names the mission, so progress through the story is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story-related. Headliners is a named story mission; it arrives in sequence as you work through the campaign, and finishing it earns the trophy. Basis: the official description names the mission directly.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story-related. VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around Vice City International Airport (VCIA); play it when the story brings you there and complete it for the trophy. Note the airport connection: the separate 'Catch Me If You Can' trophy also involves VCIA, so keep an eye out while you are in the area. Basis: the official description names the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story-related. Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission that arrives in sequence during the campaign; complete it and the trophy pops. Basis: the official description names the mission directly.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The big gold: reach 100% on the game's completion tracker. This is an umbrella goal rather than a single task — story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges across Leonida all feed the percentage. Use the in-game completion checklist (and this app's roadmap phases) to find what you are short of, and expect this to be one of the last trophies you earn. A practical way to work it: whenever this tracker shows a category below 100% while the story is long finished, that category is where your missing percentage is hiding. Many other trophies on the list are simply slices of this 100%. Basis: the official description requires attaining 100% completion.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and similar marked stunt challenges scattered across Leonida. This is a grind, so start early: whenever you pass a stunt location during other tasks, take the run at it instead of saving them all for the end. They count cumulatively, so progress made while exploring for 'The Goodtime State' is not wasted. Basis: the official description sets the target at 250 stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once — the starter data counts 9 activity types, and the trophy list itself points at most of them: races, drone races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, meditation, hunting, bowling and stunt runs all have trophies of their own elsewhere on this list. You only need to try each type, not master it, so this is a good early-game trophy: dip into each new icon type as it appears on your map, and let this trophy double as your tour of what Leonida offers. Basis: the official description requires trying each type of activity once.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them according to the starter data. Work range by range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and retry freely; medals are kept per challenge, so you can chip away at the list over several sessions. Warm up your aim here early, because the same shooting practice makes the combat trophies easier. Basis: the official description requires a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations per the starter data. Winning, not just entering, is required at each one, so learn each course's line over a couple of attempts and use your map to track which locations are still outstanding. Basis: the official description requires a win at every Top Fun Drone Race location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to new race events rather than farming a favourite. Bring a competitive vehicle for each class and tick races off as you travel between story beats. Basis: the official description requires winning 20 different races.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat his result. Fishing is one of the activity types, so find the fishing challenge, learn the catch timing on a practice round if the game allows, and then post the better haul or catch when it counts. Basis: the official description requires beating Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at an arcade cabinet in the world. Any single complete play-through of an arcade game counts, so pick whichever cabinet you find first and play it to its end rather than quitting mid-game. Basis: the official description requires completing an arcade game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: work through each of Andy's missions as they appear until the final one, and complete it. Stranger strands unlock progressively, so if Andy has no mission showing, advance the story and check the map again. This also counts toward the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'. Basis: the official description requires completing the final mission for Andy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand: complete each of Kenton's missions in order and finish the last one for the trophy. It also counts toward the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'. Basis: the official description requires completing the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand: work through Billy's missions as they unlock and complete the final one. It also counts toward the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'. Basis: the official description requires completing the final mission for Billy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named strands with their own trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — give you five; you need three more strands beyond those, so take stranger icons seriously whenever they appear on the map and always finish a strand you start. Basis: the official description requires completing 8 mission strands for strangers.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand: complete each of Randy's missions as they appear and finish the final one. It also counts toward the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'. Basis: the official description requires completing the final mission for Randy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand: work through Tyrone's missions in order and complete the last one for the trophy. It also counts toward the 8 strands needed for 'Strangers & Freaks'. Basis: the official description requires completing the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots per the starter data. Treat this as a collectible route: as you explore each region for 'The Goodtime State', stop at any meditation spot you pass and complete the meditation so it registers. Basis: the official description requires meditating at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Follow Bret's strand until the special hunt is offered, prepare suitable hunting gear, and complete the hunt as directed. Basis: the official description requires hunting a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Finish 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found out in the world, so pick them up whenever you spot one and keep track of which sets are nearly complete — finishing three complete sets matters, not the total number of loose cards. Prioritise completing your closest set before starting to chase a new one. Basis: the official description requires completing 3 Collectible Card sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different locations. This is a coverage grind like the meditation spots: do it at every new place you visit rather than hunting all 100 at the end, and pair the route with your exploration for 'The Goodtime State' and vehicle discoveries for 'Whip It Good'. Basis: the official description sets the target at 100 locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges accumulate naturally as you play activities, robberies and exploration, so check your challenge list periodically and mop up the nearly-finished ones — fifty completions arrive much faster if you deliberately close out the easy entries. Basis: the official description requires completing 50 Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape. Deliberately raise the heat to exactly four stars, break line of sight, swap vehicles or duck into cover away from the search area, and stay clean until the wanted level clears with your partner still with you. Doing this in co-op/partner play is the natural reading of the description. Basis: the official description requires losing a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escaping.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan a route of three shops close together before you start. With your partner, rob the first shop, move straight to the second and third without letting the wanted level drop in between — speed matters more than the take, so keep moving, keep the heat alive, and only escape once the third robbery registers. Basis: the official description requires robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting into or registering new vehicles as you encounter them across Leonida. Variety is the point: wealthy districts, docks, farms and highways each spawn different traffic, so make a habit of hopping into unfamiliar models instead of always driving your favourite. This pairs naturally with registering vehicles for 'On the Spot'. Basis: the official description requires discovering 100 vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Line up a crowded fight before you trigger Combat Focus: you need 5 takedowns inside one activation, so pick a moment with at least five enemies in reach, prioritise the closest targets first, and use a weapon that downs enemies quickly. If an attempt falls short, story firefights and gang operations give you plenty more chances. Basis: the official description requires taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Flagged as potentially missable. At VCIA (Vice City International Airport), make a departure that is not on the schedule — in plain terms, take off in an aircraft you were not supposed to leave in. Because this is tied to a specific location and moment, try it when the story first puts you at the airport (see 'Hi-Jacked', the VCIA Takedown mission) rather than assuming you can set it up any time; if a plane is within reach, take it and get airborne. Basis: the official description requires an unscheduled departure at VCIA; it gives no replay guarantee, so this app flags it as potentially missable.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately cryptic description: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The honest guidance the description supports is to get involved with a Rhino when one appears — military-grade hardware like this usually shows up at high wanted levels or around military sites — and survive the encounter the game sets up. Do not trust any source claiming precise steps beyond that until the description is officially unhidden. Basis: the official (hidden) description references Rhinos, the series' name for its tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store cleanly: get in, take the goods and get out without being detected. Scout the store first, avoid line-of-sight of staff and cameras, move quietly, and have your escape route planned before you start so the exit is as stealthy as the entry. If you are spotted, leave and try a fresh store rather than forcing it. Basis: the official description requires robbing a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. A robbery only counts if you get away, so plan the exit before you enter: a fast vehicle staged nearby and a route that breaks line of sight. Spread the five across different banks as you travel, and expect the heat to be heavier than a shop robbery. Basis: the official description requires robbing 5 Bank Vaults and escaping.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck in free roam, stop it, take the cash and escape the response. Block or disable the truck in a spot where you can work quickly, grab the money as soon as the doors are open, and have a getaway vehicle ready — the escape is part of the requirement, not an optional extra. Basis: the official description requires robbing an Armored Truck and escaping.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore the whole state of Leonida — 52 areas per the starter data. Work region by region and use the map's uncovered areas as your checklist; the most commonly missed spots are small islands, swamps and rural corners away from the story route. Combine the sweep with meditation spots, WAiNK locations and stunt jumps so one trip advances four trophies at once. Basis: the official description requires exploring all of Leonida.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each gang — 9 gangs per the starter data. Keep a note of which gangs you have already hit, because robbing the same gang twice does not advance the count; as you explore new territory, check who runs the local operation before you raid it. Basis: the official description requires robbing an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Flagged as potentially missable. Go to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail somewhere with a view — look for a beachfront bar or drinks spot overlooking the water and order the cocktail there. The title ('In The Beginning…') hints it belongs to the game's early hours, so try it as soon as Ocean Beach is open to you rather than leaving it for the endgame, in case the relevant spot or moment is tied to the opening. Basis: the official description requires enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach; its timing hint is why this app flags it as potentially missable.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Inside a vehicle showroom, get into one of the cars and drive it out through the glass — 'in classic style' means through the window, not politely through a door. Pick a fast car on the showroom floor, line up with the largest pane, and floor it. Basis: the official description requires smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — 'follow-through' is bowling language, so play the bowling activity there properly rather than just walking in. Basis: the official description points at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and a bowling follow-through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a cryptic description: 'A partnership with mass appeal' points at doing something notable together with your partner that draws attention. The guidance the description honestly supports: play partner/co-op activities together and lean into public, crowd-pleasing moments as a duo. Treat any source claiming exact steps with suspicion until the description is officially unhidden. Basis: the official (hidden) description references a partnership with mass appeal.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Flagged as potentially missable. This hidden trophy tracks the choices you make — the starter data notes that PSN tracks a count up to 500 — so it is earned by consistently making decisions when the game offers them rather than skipping optional interactions. Because choices belong to moments that pass, engage with optional decisions, dialogue options and either/or situations whenever they appear instead of rushing past them. Basis: the official (hidden) description is 'Choices made (for better or worse)', and choice-based progress is exactly the kind that can be missed on a passive playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Flagged as potentially missable. Another cryptic hidden trophy: 'Second time's the charm' implies failing at something and then succeeding on the retry. The honest approach: when an activity, challenge or attempt goes wrong, retry it straight away instead of moving on — a fail-then-succeed sequence is the pattern the description describes. Do not trust sources claiming a precise trigger until the description is officially unhidden. Basis: the official (hidden) description is 'Second time's the charm'.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy for witnessing something strange — the title and description are a classic UFO/easter-egg wink. The guidance the description supports: explore off the beaten path (remote swamps, mountains and night-time oddities are the series' traditional hiding places) and investigate anything that looks deliberately out of place. Expect to stumble onto this while exploring for 'The Goodtime State' rather than hunting it directly. Basis: the official (hidden) description asks 'What the hell just happened?', signalling a strange event witnessed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by — swinging a melee attack from a moving vehicle as you pass, bowling them over like a pin. Line up a lone pedestrian, keep your speed moderate so the swing connects, and use the melee attack from the driver's seat as you pass. Basis: the official description requires bowling someone over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies, so feed them into the laundering route whenever you are holding them instead of spending them raw; this builds steadily alongside the bank, truck and operation robberies elsewhere on the list. Keep a running total in mind — it is a cumulative earnings target, not a single payout. Basis: the official description requires earning $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops — any shops, any goods. Do not hoard cash: buy vehicles, clothes, gear and supplies as you play and the total climbs on its own. If you are short late in the game, expensive vehicle and property-adjacent purchases close the gap fastest. Basis: the official description requires spending $100,000 across all shops.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map — 8 garages per the starter data. Garages cost serious money, so this pairs with the earning trophies: robberies and laundering ('Dime on the Dollar') fund the purchases, and spending the money also feeds 'Treat Yo Self'. Buy them as they become affordable rather than saving for all eight at once. Basis: the official description requires purchasing all garage properties.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get into a vehicle you intend to keep or use, register it on the spot instead of abandoning it; ten registrations arrive quickly if you make it a habit while discovering vehicles for 'Whip It Good'. Basis: the official description requires registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
